Counts do not enter scores. One sequential driver per case; macOS sample PID 6 1 after a 1s startup delay; any startup stacks are excluded from canonical execute attribution. Reported attribution includes only canonical execute stacks; parsing, JIT, input import, cache flush and serialization are excluded by stack. Profiled sample times do not enter benchmark scores.
